name: McKee’s Storynomics Narrative Engine
diagnostic: What unexpected event breaks our customer's status quo, and what progressive gaps between expectation and reality must they navigate?
artifact: An Expectation-Gap Narrative Graph: Baseline Equilibrium → Inciting Incident → Object of Desire → Action → Gap (Expectation vs. Reality) → Escalating Conflict → Decisive Crisis → Re-established Equilibrium.
trap: Presenting an idealized, friction-free customer journey that fails to acknowledge real implementation obstacles.
pedigreeFull: Robert McKee & Thomas Gerace (*Storynomics*, 2018). A framework applying classical dramatic conflict mechanics to business communications.
